title.zh: 比特币矿企Genesis Digital Assets将向AI数据中心转型
title.en: Alameda-Backed Bitcoin Miner Genesis Digital Raises About $900 Million for AI Da

current_state.zh: SWI Group 在2026年6月以5亿美元收购Genesis Digital Assets控股权后，于10月12日宣布融资8亿欧元（约9亿美元），用于将Genesis Digital Assets在美国得克萨斯州、南北卡罗来纳州及瑞典的比特币矿场改造为服务大型云计算商的AI数据中心，并出售剩余的哈萨克斯坦矿场资产。
current_state.en: After acquiring a controlling stake in Genesis Digital Assets for $500 million in June 2026, SWI Group announced on October 12 €800 million (~$900 million) in financing to convert Genesis Digital Assets' bitcoin mining sites in Texas, North and South Carolina, and Sweden into AI data centers serving large cloud providers, while divesting remaining Kazakhstan mining assets.

updates.title_zh: 比特币矿企Genesis Digital Assets将向AI数据中心转型
updates.title_en: 比特币矿企Genesis Digital Assets将向AI数据中心转型
updates.what_changed_zh: SWI Group 于2026年6月以5亿美元收购Genesis Digital Assets大量股权并成为控股股东；计划利用其在美国得克萨斯州、南北卡罗来纳州及瑞典的数据中心为大型云计算服务商提供算力；并出售剩余的哈萨克斯坦矿场资产。
updates.what_changed_en: SWI Group acquired a majority stake in Genesis Digital Assets for $500 million in June 2026 and became controlling shareholder; plans to use its data centers in Texas, North and South Carolina, and Sweden to provide computing power to large cloud providers; and sell remaining Kazakhstan mining assets.

updates.current_state_en: After acquiring a controlling stake in Genesis Digital Assets for $500 million in June 2026, SWI Group announced on October 12 €800 million (~$900 million) in financing to convert Genesis Digital Assets' bitcoin mining sites in Texas, North and South Carolina, and Sweden into AI data centers serving large cloud providers, while divesting remaining Kazakhstan mining assets.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Genesis Digital Assets, now controlled by SWI Group, announced €800M (~US$900M) in financing to convert its US and Swedish bitcoin mining sites into AI data centers serving large cloud providers while divesting its Kazakhstan mining assets.
